/// UV parameterisation facts for a surface, for the topological assembler.
struct SurfInfo {
    periodic_u: bool,
    u_period: f64,
    periodic_v: bool,
    v_period: f64,
    /// V values at which U collapses to a pole (sphere ±π/2, cone apex 0).
    pole_vs: Vec<f64>,
}

fn surf_info(surface_type: &SelectedSurface, occt: &geom::HandleGeomSurface, output: &Stage3Output) -> SurfInfo {
    let s = occt.get();
    let periodic_u = s.is_u_periodic();
    let periodic_v = s.is_v_periodic();
    let pole_vs = match surface_type {
        SelectedSurface::Spherical(_) => {
            vec![-std::f64::consts::FRAC_PI_2, std::f64::consts::FRAC_PI_2]
        }
        SelectedSurface::Conical(i) => {
            if output.stage2.conical_hypotheses[*i].is_cylinder() {
                vec![]
            } else {
                vec![0.0]
            }
        }
        _ => vec![],
    };
    SurfInfo {
        periodic_u,
        u_period: if periodic_u { s.u_period() } else { 0.0 },
        periodic_v,
        v_period: if periodic_v { s.v_period() } else { 0.0 },
        pole_vs,
    }
}

/// Build a Geom2d_Line pcurve handle from origin + direction.
fn line2d(ox: f64, oy: f64, dx: f64, dy: f64) -> OwnedPtr<geom2d::HandleGeom2dCurve> {
    let o = gp::Pnt2d::new_real2(ox, oy);
    let d = gp::Dir2d::new_real2(dx, dy);
    let l = geom2d::Line::new_pnt2d_dir2d(&o, &d);
    geom2d::Line::to_handle(l).to_handle_curve()
}

/// Sample a 3D curve over [t0,t1], project onto `surface`, unwrap periodic U/V and
/// pole-borrow U, then interpolate a Geom2d pcurve. Returns the pcurve handle and
/// its start/end UV (in the sampled t0→t1 direction). `u_center`/`v_center` hint the
/// periodic branch to keep.
fn compute_pcurve(
    curve: &geom::HandleGeomCurve,
    t0: f64,
    t1: f64,
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    sinfo: &SurfInfo,
    u_center: f64,
    v_center: f64,
    config: &Config,
) -> Option<(OwnedPtr<geom2d::HandleGeom2dCurve>, (f64, f64), (f64, f64))> {
    let c = curve.get();
    let span = t1 - t0;
    if span.abs() < 1e-15 {
        return None;
    }
    let n_samples = 13usize;
    let pole_thresh = 0.1_f64;
    let is_pole = |v: f64| sinfo.pole_vs.iter().any(|&pv| (v - pv).abs() < pole_thresh);

    let mut uv: Vec<(f64, f64, f64)> = Vec::with_capacity(n_samples);
    for i in 0..n_samples {
        let t = t0 + span * (i as f64) / ((n_samples - 1) as f64);
        let pt = c.value(t);
        let proj = geom_api::ProjectPointOnSurf::new_pnt_handlegeomsurface_extalgo(
            &pt, surface, extrema::ExtAlgo::Grad,
        );
        if proj.nb_points() == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let mut u = 0.0;
        let mut v = 0.0;
        proj.lower_distance_parameters(&mut u, &mut v);
        uv.push((t, u, v));
    }
    if uv.len() < 2 {
        return None;
    }
    let last = uv.len() - 1;

    // Pole U-borrow: at a U-pole, projected U is arbitrary; borrow the nearest
    // non-pole sample's U so the pcurve endpoint has a definite U.
    if !sinfo.pole_vs.is_empty() {
        for i in 0..uv.len() {
            if is_pole(uv[i].2) {
                let mut bu = None;
                for d in 1..uv.len() {
                    if i >= d && !is_pole(uv[i - d].2) {
                        bu = Some(uv[i - d].1);
                        break;
                    }
                    if i + d < uv.len() && !is_pole(uv[i + d].2) {
                        bu = Some(uv[i + d].1);
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if let Some(u) = bu {
                    uv[i].1 = u;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Unwrap U for continuity, keeping the first sample near u_center.
    if sinfo.periodic_u {
        let p = sinfo.u_period;
        let h = p / 2.0;
        while uv[0].1 < u_center - h {
            uv[0].1 += p;
        }
        while uv[0].1 > u_center + h {
            uv[0].1 -= p;
        }
        for i in 1..uv.len() {
            let prev = uv[i - 1].1;
            while uv[i].1 < prev - h {
                uv[i].1 += p;
            }
            while uv[i].1 > prev + h {
                uv[i].1 -= p;
            }
        }
    }
    if sinfo.periodic_v {
        let p = sinfo.v_period;
        let h = p / 2.0;
        while uv[0].2 < v_center - h {
            uv[0].2 += p;
        }
        while uv[0].2 > v_center + h {
            uv[0].2 -= p;
        }
        for i in 1..uv.len() {
            let prev = uv[i - 1].2;
            while uv[i].2 < prev - h {
                uv[i].2 += p;
            }
            while uv[i].2 > prev + h {
                uv[i].2 -= p;
            }
        }
    }

    let start_uv = (uv[0].1, uv[0].2);
    let end_uv = (uv[last].1, uv[last].2);

    // Interpolate the projected UV points into a Geom2d curve.
    let n = uv.len() as i32;
    let mut pts_h = t_colgp::HArray1OfPnt2d::new_int2(1, n);
    let mut params_h = t_col_std::HArray1OfReal::new_int2(1, n);
    for (idx, &(t, u, v)) in uv.iter().enumerate() {
        let pnt2d = gp::Pnt2d::new_real2(u, v);
        pts_h.change_array1().set_value((idx + 1) as i32, &pnt2d);
        params_h.change_array1().set_value((idx + 1) as i32, &t);
    }
    let pts_handle = t_colgp::HArray1OfPnt2d::to_handle(pts_h);
    let params_handle = t_col_std::HArray1OfReal::to_handle(params_h);
    let mut interp = geom2d_api::Interpolate::new_handletcolgpharray1ofpnt2d_handletcolstdharray1ofreal_bool_real(
        &pts_handle, &params_handle, false, 1e-10,
    );
    interp.perform();
    if !interp.is_done() {
        // Linear fallback: a straight 2D line through the endpoints, parameterised
        // to match [t0,t1].
        let (u1, v1) = start_uv;
        let (u2, v2) = end_uv;
        let du = u2 - u1;
        let dv = v2 - v1;
        let len = (du * du + dv * dv).sqrt();
        if len < 1e-15 {
            return None;
        }
        let dir_x = du / len;
        let dir_y = dv / len;
        let ox = u1 - t0 * dir_x;
        let oy = v1 - t0 * dir_y;
        let _ = config;
        return Some((line2d(ox, oy, dir_x, dir_y), start_uv, end_uv));
    }
    Some((interp.curve().to_handle_curve(), start_uv, end_uv))
}

/// Attach a pcurve to a shared edge for `surface`.
fn attach_pcurve(
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    edge: &topo_ds::Edge,
    pcurve: &geom2d::HandleGeom2dCurve,
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    tol: f64,
) {
    let loc = top_loc::Location::new();
    builder.update_edge_edge_handlegeom2dcurve_handlegeomsurface_location_real(
        edge, pcurve, surface, &loc, tol,
    );
}

/// Project a 3D point onto `surface`, returning (u, v).
fn project_uv(pt: &gp::Pnt, surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface) -> Option<(f64, f64)> {
    let proj = geom_api::ProjectPointOnSurf::new_pnt_handlegeomsurface_extalgo(
        pt, surface, extrema::ExtAlgo::Grad,
    );
    if proj.nb_points() == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut u = 0.0;
    let mut v = 0.0;
    proj.lower_distance_parameters(&mut u, &mut v);
    Some((u, v))
}

/// Info about a full-revolution circle boundary edge on a periodic surface.
struct RingEdge {
    ei: usize,
    v: f64,
    /// UV of the seam vertex end (u≈0) and the far end after a full turn.
    start_u: f64,
    end_u: f64,
}

/// Build a full-revolution periodic face (all boundary edges are iso-V circles
/// spanning the full 2π in U): a cylinder/cone-frustum/sphere-band/torus-ring
/// bounded by two circles, joined by a seam edge. Pole caps (one circle + apex)
/// are handled here too.
fn build_full_revolution_face(
    fi: usize,
    output: &Stage3Output,
    edge_topos: &[EdgeTopo],
    sinfo: &SurfInfo,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    config: &Config,
) -> Result<OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Face>, Stage3Error> {
    use top_abs::Orientation::{Forward, Reversed};
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let surface = &fd.surface;
    let tol = config.vertex_tolerance_mm;
    let two_pi = 2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI;

    // Attach each circle's iso-V pcurve and record its V + U span.
    let mut rings: Vec<RingEdge> = Vec::new();
    for &ei in &fd.edge_indices {
        let et = &edge_topos[ei];
        let curve = output.edges[ei].curve_3d.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
            Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!("topo: full-rev face {fi} edge {ei} has no curve"))
        })?;
        let t0 = et.seam_param;
        let t1 = et.seam_param + two_pi;
        let mid = curve.get().value((t0 + t1) * 0.5);
        let (_, v) = project_uv(&mid, surface).unwrap_or((0.0, 0.0));
        let (pcurve, s_uv, e_uv) = compute_pcurve(curve, t0, t1, surface, sinfo, std::f64::consts::PI, v, config)
            .ok_or_else(|| Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
                "topo: full-rev face {fi} edge {ei}: pcurve failed"
            )))?;
        attach_pcurve(builder, &et.edge, &pcurve, surface, tol);
        rings.push(RingEdge { ei, v, start_u: s_uv.0, end_u: e_uv.0 });
    }

    if rings.len() != 2 {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
            "topo: full-rev face {fi}: {} ring edges (only 2-ring bands supported so far)",
            rings.len()
        )));
    }

    // Sort so ring[0] is the lower-V circle.
    rings.sort_by(|a, b| a.v.partial_cmp(&b.v).unwrap());
    let (v_lo, v_hi) = (rings[0].v, rings[1].v);

    // Seam vertices on each circle.
    let sv_lo = edge_topos[rings[0].ei].seam_vertex.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
        Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!("topo: full-rev face {fi}: lower ring has no seam vertex"))
    })?;
    let sv_hi = edge_topos[rings[1].ei].seam_vertex.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
        Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!("topo: full-rev face {fi}: upper ring has no seam vertex"))
    })?;

    // Seam edge: iso-U generator at U=0 from v_lo to v_hi, with two pcurves
    // (U=0 and U=2π).
    let iso = surface.get().u_iso(0.0);
    let mut seam_me = b_rep_builder_api::MakeEdge::new_handlegeomcurve_vertex2_real2(
        &iso, sv_lo, sv_hi, v_lo, v_hi,
    );
    if !seam_me.is_done() {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
            "topo: full-rev face {fi}: seam MakeEdge failed: {:?}", seam_me.error()
        )));
    }
    let seam_edge = seam_me.edge().to_owned();
    let loc = top_loc::Location::new();
    // C1 at U=0, C2 at U=2π; both parameterised by V over [v_lo, v_hi].
    let pc_u0 = line2d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    let pc_u2 = line2d(two_pi, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    builder.update_edge_edge_handlegeom2dcurve2_handlegeomsurface_location_real(
        &seam_edge, &pc_u0, &pc_u2, surface, &loc, tol,
    );
    builder.range_edge_real2_bool(&seam_edge, v_lo, v_hi, false);

    // Orient each ring so its pcurve is traversed in +U (0 → 2π).
    let ring_orient = |r: &RingEdge| if r.end_u >= r.start_u { Forward } else { Reversed };

    // CCW wire in UV: bottom circle +U, seam up (U=2π), top circle −U, seam down (U=0).
    let mut wire = topo_ds::Wire::new();
    builder.make_wire(&mut wire);
    let e_bot = edge_topos[rings[0].ei].edge.as_shape().oriented(ring_orient(&rings[0]));
    builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &e_bot);
    let e_seam_f = seam_edge.as_shape().oriented(Forward);
    builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &e_seam_f);
    let e_top = edge_topos[rings[1].ei].edge.as_shape().oriented(match ring_orient(&rings[1]) {
        Forward => Reversed,
        _ => Forward,
    });
    builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &e_top);
    let e_seam_r = seam_edge.as_shape().oriented(Reversed);
    builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &e_seam_r);

    let mut face = topo_ds::Face::new();
    builder.make_face_face_handlegeomsurface_real(&mut face, surface, tol);
    builder.add(face.as_shape_mut(), wire.as_shape());
    Ok(face)
}

/// Dispatch a periodic (revolved) face to the appropriate builder.
fn build_periodic_face_topo(
    fi: usize,
    output: &Stage3Output,
    edge_topos: &[EdgeTopo],
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    config: &Config,
) -> Result<OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Face>, Stage3Error> {
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let stype = &output.stage2.selected_surfaces[fd.selected_surface_idx];
    let sinfo = surf_info(stype, &fd.surface, output);

    if fd.edge_indices.is_empty() {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
            "topo: periodic face {fi} has no edges (natural-bounds case not yet supported)"
        )));
    }

    let all_closed = fd.edge_indices.iter().all(|&ei| edge_topos[ei].closed_loop);
    if all_closed {
        build_full_revolution_face(fi, output, edge_topos, &sinfo, builder, config)
    } else {
        Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
            "topo: periodic face {fi}: partial-revolution not yet supported"
        )))
    }
}

    if !seam_me.is_done() {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
            "topo: full-rev face {fi}: seam MakeEdge failed: {:?}", seam_me.error()
        )));
    }
    let seam_edge = seam_me.edge().to_owned();
    let loc = top_loc::Location::new();
    // C1 at U=0, C2 at U=2π; both parameterised by V over [v_lo, v_hi].
    let pc_u0 = line2d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    let pc_u2 = line2d(two_pi, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    builder.update_edge_edge_handlegeom2dcurve2_handlegeomsurface_location_real(
        &seam_edge, &pc_u0, &pc_u2, surface, &loc, tol,
    );
    builder.range_edge_real2_bool(&seam_edge, v_lo, v_hi, false);

    // Orient each ring so its pcurve is traversed in +U (0 → 2π).
    let ring_orient = |r: &RingEdge| if r.end_u >= r.start_u { Forward } else { Reversed };

    // CCW wire in UV: bottom circle +U, seam up (U=2π), top circle −U, seam down (U=0).
    let mut wire = topo_ds::Wire::new();
    builder.make_wire(&mut wire);
    let e_bot = edge_topos[rings[0].ei].edge.as_shape().oriented(ring_orient(&rings[0]));
    builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &e_bot);
    let e_seam_f = seam_edge.as_shape().oriented(Forward);
    builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &e_seam_f);
    let e_top = edge_topos[rings[1].ei].edge.as_shape().oriented(match ring_orient(&rings[1]) {
        Forward => Reversed,
        _ => Forward,
    });
    builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &e_top);
    let e_seam_r = seam_edge.as_shape().oriented(Reversed);
    builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &e_seam_r);

    let mut face = topo_ds::Face::new();
    builder.make_face_face_handlegeomsurface_real(&mut face, surface, tol);
    builder.add(face.as_shape_mut(), wire.as_shape());
    Ok(face)
}

```
/// Info about a full-revolution circle boundary edge on a periodic surface.
struct RingEdge {
    ei: usize,
    v: f64,
    /// U at the seam vertex end (≈0) and the far end after a full turn (≈±2π).
    start_u: f64,
    end_u: f64,
}

/// Build a seam edge along the U=0 iso-generator between two vertices at V=va,vb
/// (va<vb), carrying two pcurves (U=0 and U=2π). Used by bands and caps.
fn make_seam_edge(
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    sv_a: &topo_ds::Vertex,
    va: f64,
    sv_b: &topo_ds::Vertex,
    vb: f64,
    u_period: f64,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    tol: f64,
) -> Result<OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Edge>, Stage3Error> {
    let iso = surface.get().u_iso(0.0);
    let mut me = b_rep_builder_api::MakeEdge::new_handlegeomcurve_vertex2_real2(&iso, sv_a, sv_b, va, vb);
    if !me.is_done() {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
            "topo: seam MakeEdge failed: {:?}", me.error()
        )));
    }
    let seam = me.edge().to_owned();
    let loc = top_loc::Location::new();
    let pc0 = line2d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    let pc2 = line2d(u_period, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    builder.update_edge_edge_handlegeom2dcurve2_handlegeomsurface_location_real(
        &seam, &pc0, &pc2, surface, &loc, tol,
    );
    builder.range_edge_real2_bool(&seam, va, vb, false);
    Ok(seam)
}

/// Build a degenerate pole edge (single point) at V=`v_pole`, with a pcurve that
/// is the iso-V line U:0→2π. Returns the edge (already carrying its collapsed vertex).
fn make_pole_edge(
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    v_pole: f64,
    u_period: f64,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    tol: f64,
) -> OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Edge> {
    use top_abs::Orientation::{Forward, Reversed};
    let apex_pt = surface.get().value(0.0, v_pole);
    let mut amv = b_rep_builder_api::MakeVertex::new_pnt(&apex_pt);
    let av = amv.vertex().to_owned();
    builder.update_vertex_vertex_real(&av, tol);

    let mut degen = topo_ds::Edge::new();
    builder.make_edge_edge(&mut degen);
    builder.degenerated(&degen, true);
    let loc = top_loc::Location::new();
    let pc = line2d(0.0, v_pole, 1.0, 0.0);
    builder.update_edge_edge_handlegeom2dcurve_handlegeomsurface_location_real(
        &degen, &pc, surface, &loc, tol,
    );
    builder.range_edge_real2_bool(&degen, 0.0, u_period, false);
    let v_fwd = av.as_shape().oriented(Forward);
    let v_rev = av.as_shape().oriented(Reversed);
    builder.add(degen.as_shape_mut(), &v_fwd);
    builder.add(degen.as_shape_mut(), &v_rev);
    builder.update_vertex_vertex_real_edge_real(&av, 0.0, &degen, tol);
    degen
}

/// Build a full-revolution periodic face: all boundary edges are iso-V circles
/// spanning the full 2π in U. Two circles → a band (cylinder/cone-frustum/
/// sphere-band/torus-ring); one circle + a pole → a cap (cone apex / hemisphere).
fn build_full_revolution_face(
    fi: usize,
    output: &Stage3Output,
    edge_topos: &[EdgeTopo],
    sinfo: &SurfInfo,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    config: &Config,
) -> Result<OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Face>, Stage3Error> {
    use top_abs::Orientation::{Forward, Reversed};
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let surface = &fd.surface;
    let tol = config.vertex_tolerance_mm;
    let two_pi = 2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI;

    // Attach each circle's iso-V pcurve and record its V + U span.
    let mut rings: Vec<RingEdge> = Vec::new();
    for &ei in &fd.edge_indices {
        let et = &edge_topos[ei];
        let curve = output.edges[ei].curve_3d.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
            Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!("topo: full-rev face {fi} edge {ei} has no curve"))
        })?;
        let t0 = et.seam_param;
        let t1 = et.seam_param + two_pi;
        let mid = curve.get().value((t0 + t1) * 0.5);
        let (_, v) = project_uv(&mid, surface).unwrap_or((0.0, 0.0));
        let (pcurve, s_uv, e_uv) = compute_pcurve(curve, t0, t1, surface, sinfo, std::f64::consts::PI, v, config)
            .ok_or_else(|| Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
                "topo: full-rev face {fi} edge {ei}: pcurve failed"
            )))?;
        attach_pcurve(builder, &et.edge, &pcurve, surface, tol);
        rings.push(RingEdge { ei, v, start_u: s_uv.0, end_u: e_uv.0 });
    }
    rings.sort_by(|a, b| a.v.partial_cmp(&b.v).unwrap());

    // Orient a ring edge so its pcurve is traversed in +U (0 → 2π), or −U.
    let ring_orient_plus = |r: &RingEdge| if r.end_u >= r.start_u { Forward } else { Reversed };
    let ring_edge = |r: &RingEdge, plus: bool| {
        let base = ring_orient_plus(r);
        let o = if plus { base } else { match base { Forward => Reversed, _ => Forward } };
        edge_topos[r.ei].edge.as_shape().oriented(o)
    };

    let mut wire = topo_ds::Wire::new();
    builder.make_wire(&mut wire);

    if rings.len() == 2 {
        // Band: bottom circle +U, seam up, top circle −U, seam down.
        let sv_lo = edge_topos[rings[0].ei].seam_vertex.as_ref().unwrap();
        let sv_hi = edge_topos[rings[1].ei].seam_vertex.as_ref().unwrap();
        let seam = make_seam_edge(surface, sv_lo, rings[0].v, sv_hi, rings[1].v, two_pi, builder, tol)?;
        builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &ring_edge(&rings[0], true));
        builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &seam.as_shape().oriented(Forward));
        builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &ring_edge(&rings[1], false));
        builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &seam.as_shape().oriented(Reversed));
    } else if rings.len() == 1 {
        // Cap: one circle + a pole. Choose the pole the face extends toward.
        let ring = &rings[0];
        let v_ring = ring.v;
        let v_pole = pick_cap_pole(fi, output, sinfo, v_ring);
        let sv_ring = edge_topos[ring.ei].seam_vertex.as_ref().unwrap();
        let pole_edge = make_pole_edge(surface, v_pole, two_pi, builder, tol);
        // Pole vertex, for the seam's far end.
        let pole_vertex = top_exp::last_vertex(&pole_edge, true).to_owned();
        if v_pole > v_ring {
            // Pole above: circle +U, seam up, degenerate (−U), seam down.
            let seam = make_seam_edge(surface, sv_ring, v_ring, &pole_vertex, v_pole, two_pi, builder, tol)?;
            builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &ring_edge(ring, true));
            builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &seam.as_shape().oriented(Forward));
            builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &pole_edge.as_shape().oriented(Reversed));
            builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &seam.as_shape().oriented(Reversed));
        } else {
            // Pole below: degenerate (+U), seam up, circle −U, seam down.
            let seam = make_seam_edge(surface, &pole_vertex, v_pole, sv_ring, v_ring, two_pi, builder, tol)?;
            builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &pole_edge.as_shape().oriented(Forward));
            builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &seam.as_shape().oriented(Forward));
            builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &ring_edge(ring, false));
            builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &seam.as_shape().oriented(Reversed));
        }
    } else {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
            "topo: full-rev face {fi}: {} ring edges (expected 1 cap or 2 band)",
            rings.len()
        )));
    }

    let mut face = topo_ds::Face::new();
    builder.make_face_face_handlegeomsurface_real(&mut face, surface, tol);
    builder.add(face.as_shape_mut(), wire.as_shape());
    Ok(face)
}

/// Choose which pole (from sinfo.pole_vs) a single-ring cap face extends toward,
/// by projecting a representative mesh-face centroid onto the surface.
fn pick_cap_pole(fi: usize, output: &Stage3Output, sinfo: &SurfInfo, v_ring: f64) -> f64 {
    if sinfo.pole_vs.len() == 1 {
        return sinfo.pole_vs[0];
    }
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let mesh_faces = surface_faces(&output.stage2.selected_surfaces[fd.selected_surface_idx], &output.stage2);
    let v_mesh = mesh_faces.first().map(|&mf| {
        let c = compute_mesh_face_centroid(mf, &output.stage2.mesh);
        let cp = gp::Pnt::new_real3(c[0], c[1], c[2]);
        project_uv(&cp, &fd.surface).map(|(_, v)| v).unwrap_or(v_ring)
    }).unwrap_or(v_ring);
    // Pick the pole on the same side of the ring as the mesh centroid.
    sinfo.pole_vs.iter().copied()
        .max_by(|&a, &b| {
            let da = if (v_mesh - v_ring).signum() == (a - v_ring).signum() { (a - v_ring).abs() } else { -1.0 };
            let db = if (v_mesh - v_ring).signum() == (b - v_ring).signum() { (b - v_ring).abs() } else { -1.0 };
            da.partial_cmp(&db).unwrap()
        })
        .unwrap_or(sinfo.pole_vs[0])
}

/// Build a seam edge along the U=0 iso-generator between two vertices, carrying
/// two pcurves (U=0 and U=2π). The V (= iso-curve) parameters are found by
/// projecting the actual vertices onto the iso curve, so the edge is
/// SameParameter-consistent regardless of small fitting-driven V differences.
/// Used by bands and caps.
fn make_seam_edge(
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    sv_a: &topo_ds::Vertex,
    sv_b: &topo_ds::Vertex,
    u_period: f64,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    tol: f64,
) -> Result<OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Edge>, Stage3Error> {
    let iso = surface.get().u_iso(0.0).to_handle_curve();
    let pa = b_rep::Tool::pnt(sv_a);
    let pb = b_rep::Tool::pnt(sv_b);
    let proja = geom_api::ProjectPointOnCurve::new_pnt_handlegeomcurve(&pa, &iso);
    let projb = geom_api::ProjectPointOnCurve::new_pnt_handlegeomcurve(&pb, &iso);
    if proja.nb_points() == 0 || projb.nb_points() == 0 {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError("topo: seam vertex projection onto iso failed".into()));
    }
    let ta = proja.lower_distance_parameter();
    let tb = projb.lower_distance_parameter();
    let (v_a, v_b, first, second) = if ta <= tb { (ta, tb, sv_a, sv_b) } else { (tb, ta, sv_b, sv_a) };
    let mut me = b_rep_builder_api::MakeEdge::new_handlegeomcurve_vertex2_real2(&iso, first, second, v_a, v_b);
    if !me.is_done() {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
            "topo: seam MakeEdge failed: {:?}", me.error()
        )));
    }
    let seam = me.edge().to_owned();
    let loc = top_loc::Location::new();
    let pc0 = line2d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    let pc2 = line2d(u_period, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    builder.update_edge_edge_handlegeom2dcurve2_handlegeomsurface_location_real(
        &seam, &pc0, &pc2, surface, &loc, tol,
    );
    builder.range_edge_real2_bool(&seam, v_a, v_b, false);
    Ok(seam)
}

The failure is a real topology issue: cone_cylinder's cone (axis −z) and cylinder (axis +z) are coaxial but anti-parallel, so their surface `U=0` azimuths differ. A shared circle's seam vertex placed at one face's `U=0` lands at a different U on the other face — and a face's two circles end up with seam vertices at inconsistent azimuths. 

The fix: place each circle's seam vertex at a **circle-intrinsic canonical azimuth** (sign-independent of axis direction), so all coaxial faces agree; then each face builds its seam at the vertex's *actual* U on its surface (not hardcoded 0). Let me add the geometry helpers and thread `u_seam` through.

```
/// Estimate a circle edge's (center, unit normal, radius) by sampling its 3D curve.
fn circle_frame(curve: &geom::HandleGeomCurve) -> ([f64; 3], [f64; 3], f64) {
    let c = curve.get();
    let fp = c.first_parameter();
    let lp = c.last_parameter();
    let span = lp - fp;
    let n = 16usize;
    let mut pts: Vec<[f64; 3]> = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    for i in 0..n {
        let t = fp + span * (i as f64) / (n as f64);
        let p = c.value(t);
        pts.push([p.x(), p.y(), p.z()]);
    }
    let mut center = [0.0; 3];
    for p in &pts {
        for k in 0..3 {
            center[k] += p[k];
        }
    }
    for k in 0..3 {
        center[k] /= n as f64;
    }
    let mut normal = [0.0; 3];
    for i in 0..n {
        let a = [pts[i][0] - center[0], pts[i][1] - center[1], pts[i][2] - center[2]];
        let j = (i + 1) % n;
        let b = [pts[j][0] - center[0], pts[j][1] - center[1], pts[j][2] - center[2]];
        normal[0] += a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1];
        normal[1] += a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2];
        normal[2] += a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0];
    }
    let nl = (normal[0] * normal[0] + normal[1] * normal[1] + normal[2] * normal[2]).sqrt();
    if nl > 1e-12 {
        for k in 0..3 {
            normal[k] /= nl;
        }
    }
    let radius = pts.iter().map(|p| {
        ((p[0] - center[0]).powi(2) + (p[1] - center[1]).powi(2) + (p[2] - center[2]).powi(2)).sqrt()
    }).sum::<f64>() / n as f64;
    (center, normal, radius)
}

/// A canonical unit direction perpendicular to `axis`, independent of the sign of
/// `axis`. Coaxial circles (whatever the surface's axis-direction sign) therefore
/// get the same seam azimuth, so all faces sharing a circle agree on the seam.
fn canonical_perp(axis: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    // Canonicalise the sign: make the dominant component positive.
    let mut n = axis;
    let (ax, ay, az) = (n[0].abs(), n[1].abs(), n[2].abs());
    let sign = if ax >= ay && ax >= az {
        n[0]
    } else if ay >= az {
        n[1]
    } else {
        n[2]
    };
    if sign < 0.0 {
        n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]];
    }
    // Cross with whichever axis is least aligned with n.
    let e = if ax <= ay && ax <= az {
        [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    } else if ay <= az {
        [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]
    } else {
        [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    };
    let mut p = [
        n[1] * e[2] - n[2] * e[1],
        n[2] * e[0] - n[0] * e[2],
        n[0] * e[1] - n[1] * e[0],
    ];
    let pl = (p[0] * p[0] + p[1] * p[1] + p[2] * p[2]).sqrt();
    if pl > 1e-12 {
        for k in 0..3 {
            p[k] /= pl;
        }
    }
    p
}

/// Build a seam edge along the U=0 iso-generator between two vertices, carrying
/// two pcurves (U=0 and U=2π). The V (= iso-curve) parameters are found by
/// projecting the actual vertices onto the iso curve, so the edge is
/// SameParameter-consistent regardless of small fitting-driven V differences.
/// Used by bands and caps.
fn make_seam_edge(
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    sv_a: &topo_ds::Vertex,
    sv_b: &topo_ds::Vertex,
    u_period: f64,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    tol: f64,
) -> Result<OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Edge>, Stage3Error> {
    let iso = surface.get().u_iso(0.0);
    let pa = b_rep::Tool::pnt(sv_a);
    let pb = b_rep::Tool::pnt(sv_b);
    let proja = geom_api::ProjectPointOnCurve::new_pnt_handlegeomcurve(&pa, &iso);
    let projb = geom_api::ProjectPointOnCurve::new_pnt_handlegeomcurve(&pb, &iso);
    if proja.nb_points() == 0 || projb.nb_points() == 0 {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError("topo: seam vertex projection onto iso failed".into()));
    }
    let ta = proja.lower_distance_parameter();
    let tb = projb.lower_distance_parameter();
    let (v_a, v_b, first, second) = if ta <= tb { (ta, tb, sv_a, sv_b) } else { (tb, ta, sv_b, sv_a) };
    let mut me = b_rep_builder_api::MakeEdge::new_handlegeomcurve_vertex2_real2(&iso, first, second, v_a, v_b);
    if !me.is_done() {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
            "topo: seam MakeEdge failed: {:?}", me.error()
        )));
    }
    let seam = me.edge().to_owned();
    let loc = top_loc::Location::new();
    let pc0 = line2d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    let pc2 = line2d(u_period, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    builder.update_edge_edge_handlegeom2dcurve2_handlegeomsurface_location_real(
        &seam, &pc0, &pc2, surface, &loc, tol,
    );
    builder.range_edge_real2_bool(&seam, v_a, v_b, false);
    Ok(seam)
}
```

**After:**
```
/// Build a seam edge along the U=`u_seam` iso-generator between two vertices,
/// carrying two pcurves (U=u_seam and U=u_seam+period). The V (= iso-curve)
/// parameters are found by projecting the actual vertices onto the iso curve, so
/// the edge is SameParameter-consistent; vertex tolerances are widened to cover
/// the fitting gap between the analytic iso and the fitted circle. Used by bands
/// and caps.
fn make_seam_edge(
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    sv_a: &topo_ds::Vertex,
    sv_b: &topo_ds::Vertex,
    u_seam: f64,
    u_period: f64,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    tol: f64,
) -> Result<OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Edge>, Stage3Error> {
    let iso = surface.get().u_iso(u_seam);
    let pa = b_rep::Tool::pnt(sv_a);
    let pb = b_rep::Tool::pnt(sv_b);
    let proja = geom_api::ProjectPointOnCurve::new_pnt_handlegeomcurve(&pa, &iso);
    let projb = geom_api::ProjectPointOnCurve::new_pnt_handlegeomcurve(&pb, &iso);
    if proja.nb_points() == 0 || projb.nb_points() == 0 {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError("topo: seam vertex projection onto iso failed".into()));
    }
    let ta = proja.lower_distance_parameter();
    let tb = projb.lower_distance_parameter();
    // Widen vertex tolerances to cover the analytic-iso vs fitted-circle gap.
    builder.update_vertex_vertex_real(sv_a, proja.lower_distance().max(tol) * 1.05);
    builder.update_vertex_vertex_real(sv_b, projb.lower_distance().max(tol) * 1.05);
    let (v_a, v_b, first, second) = if ta <= tb { (ta, tb, sv_a, sv_b) } else { (tb, ta, sv_b, sv_a) };
    let mut me = b_rep_builder_api::MakeEdge::new_handlegeomcurve_vertex2_real2(&iso, first, second, v_a, v_b);
    if !me.is_done() {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
            "topo: seam MakeEdge failed: {:?}", me.error()
        )));
    }
    let seam = me.edge().to_owned();
    let loc = top_loc::Location::new();
    let pc0 = line2d(u_seam, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    let pc2 = line2d(u_seam + u_period, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    builder.update_edge_edge_handlegeom2dcurve2_handlegeomsurface_location_real(
        &seam, &pc0, &pc2, surface, &loc, tol,
    );
    builder.range_edge_real2_bool(&seam, v_a, v_b, false);
    Ok(seam)
}

The pole choices are correct — this is an orientation problem, and it's not a clean flip (block+bulge vs block−pocket are different closed surfaces), which means my hand-wound wire orientations aren't reliably outward-consistent. 

The robust, principled fix: in OCCT a face's **normal** is `surface_normal` if Forward, `−surface_normal` if Reversed — *independent of the wire winding* (the wire only selects the region). So I should orient each face **outward using the mesh normal as ground truth**, making the shell consistent-and-outward by construction. Let me find the existing mesh-normal/centroid helpers.

/// Orientation (Forward/Reversed) that makes face `fi`'s normal point outward,
/// matching the mesh. In OCCT a face's normal is the surface normal when Forward,
/// negated when Reversed — independent of the wire winding — so this reliably
/// orients every face outward regardless of how its boundary loop was wound.
fn face_outward_orientation(fi: usize, output: &Stage3Output) -> top_abs::Orientation {
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let stype = &output.stage2.selected_surfaces[fd.selected_surface_idx];
    let mesh = &output.stage2.mesh;
    let mfaces = surface_faces(stype, &output.stage2);
    if mfaces.is_empty() {
        return top_abs::Orientation::Forward;
    }
    // Average several mesh-face outward normals (mesh winding is outward).
    let mut mn = [0.0f64; 3];
    for &mf in mfaces.iter().take(32) {
        let f = &mesh.faces[mf];
        let a = &mesh.vertices[f.vertex_indices[0]];
        let b = &mesh.vertices[f.vertex_indices[1]];
        let c = &mesh.vertices[f.vertex_indices[2]];
        let ab = [b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y, b.z - a.z];
        let ac = [c.x - a.x, c.y - a.y, c.z - a.z];
        let n = [
            ab[1] * ac[2] - ab[2] * ac[1],
            ab[2] * ac[0] - ab[0] * ac[2],
            ab[0] * ac[1] - ab[1] * ac[0],
        ];
        let l = (n[0] * n[0] + n[1] * n[1] + n[2] * n[2]).sqrt();
        if l > 1e-15 {
            for k in 0..3 {
                mn[k] += n[k] / l;
            }
        }
    }
    // Surface geometric normal (Forward-face normal) at a representative centroid.
    let cen = compute_mesh_face_centroid(mfaces[0], mesh);
    let cp = gp::Pnt::new_real3(cen[0], cen[1], cen[2]);
    let (u, v) = match project_uv(&cp, &fd.surface) {
        Some(uv) => uv,
        None => return top_abs::Orientation::Forward,
    };
    let mut p = gp::Pnt::new_real3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    let mut du = gp::Vec::new_real3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    let mut dv = gp::Vec::new_real3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    fd.surface.get().d1(u, v, &mut p, &mut du, &mut dv);
    let sn = [
        du.y() * dv.z() - du.z() * dv.y(),
        du.z() * dv.x() - du.x() * dv.z(),
        du.x() * dv.y() - du.y() * dv.x(),
    ];
    let dot = mn[0] * sn[0] + mn[1] * sn[1] + mn[2] * sn[2];
    if dot >= 0.0 {
        top_abs::Orientation::Forward
    } else {
        top_abs::Orientation::Reversed
    }
}

fn build_planar_face_topo(
    fi: usize,
    output: &Stage3Output,

    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    config: &Config,
) -> Result<OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Face>, Stage3Error> {

```
/// Signed area of a wire in the surface's UV space (shoelace over the wire's
/// pcurves, in the edges' oriented direction). Positive ≈ counter-clockwise.
fn wire_uv_signed_area(wire: &topo_ds::Wire, surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface) -> f64 {
    let loc = top_loc::Location::new();
    let mut pts: Vec<(f64, f64)> = Vec::new();
    let mut we = b_rep_tools::WireExplorer::new_wire(wire);
    while we.more() {
        let edge = we.current();
        let mut first = 0.0;
        let mut last = 0.0;
        let c2d = b_rep::Tool::curve_on_surface_edge_handlegeomsurface_location_real2_boolptr(
            edge, surface, &loc, &mut first, &mut last, None,
        );
        if !c2d.is_null() {
            let c = c2d.get();
            let reversed = edge.as_shape().orientation() == top_abs::Orientation::Reversed;
            let n = 8;
            for i in 0..n {
                let f = i as f64 / n as f64;
                let t = if reversed {
                    last + (first - last) * f
                } else {
                    first + (last - first) * f
                };
                let p = c.value(t);
                pts.push((p.x(), p.y()));
            }
        }
        we.next();
    }
    let mut area = 0.0;
    let m = pts.len();
    for i in 0..m {
        let j = (i + 1) % m;
        area += pts[i].0 * pts[j].1 - pts[j].0 * pts[i].1;
    }
    area * 0.5
}

/// Finalise a face from its wires: wind the outer wire CCW and holes CW in UV,
/// build the TopoDS_Face, and choose the Forward/Reversed orientation that makes
/// the face normal point outward (per the mesh). These two invariants make the
/// assembled shell consistently outward by construction.
fn finalize_face(
    fi: usize,
    output: &Stage3Output,
    wires: Vec<(OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Wire>, bool)>,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    config: &Config,
) -> Result<(OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Face>, top_abs::Orientation), Stage3Error> {
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let surface = &fd.surface;
    let mut face = topo_ds::Face::new();
    builder.make_face_face_handlegeomsurface_real(&mut face, surface, config.vertex_tolerance_mm);
    for (wire, is_outer) in &wires {
        let area = wire_uv_signed_area(wire, surface);
        // Outer wire wants positive (CCW) area; holes want negative (CW).
        let ok = (area >= 0.0) == *is_outer;
        let w = if ok {
            wire.as_shape().to_owned()
        } else {
            wire.as_shape().oriented(top_abs::Orientation::Reversed)
        };
        builder.add(face.as_shape_mut(), &w);
    }
    let orient = face_outward_orientation(fi, output);
    Ok((face, orient))
}

/// Build a planar face's wires from shared edges, attach pcurves, and finalise.
fn build_planar_face_topo(
    fi: usize,
    output: &Stage3Output,
    edge_topos: &[EdgeTopo],
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    config: &Config,
) -> Result<(OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Face>, top_abs::Orientation), Stage3Error> {
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let surface = &fd.surface;
    let tol = config.vertex_tolerance_mm;
    let sinfo = surf_info(&output.stage2.selected_surfaces[fd.selected_surface_idx], surface, output);
    let groups = group_edges_into_wires(fd, &output.edges);
    if groups.is_empty() {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!("topo: planar face {fi} has no edges")));
    }

    // Attach a pcurve for this plane to each edge (needed for the UV signed-area
    // check and for a valid B-rep face).
    for &ei in &fd.edge_indices {
        if let Some(curve) = output.edges[ei].curve_3d.as_ref() {
            let c = curve.get();
            if let Some((pc, _, _)) = compute_pcurve(curve, c.first_parameter(), c.last_parameter(), surface, &sinfo, 0.0, 0.0, config) {
                attach_pcurve(builder, &edge_topos[ei].edge, &pc, surface, tol);
            }
        }
    }

    let outer_gi = groups.iter().enumerate().max_by_key(|(_, g)| g.len()).map(|(i, _)| i).unwrap();
    let mut wires: Vec<(OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Wire>, bool)> = Vec::new();
    for (gi, group) in groups.iter().enumerate() {
        let ordered = order_wire_edges(group, edge_topos);
        let mut wire = topo_ds::Wire::new();
        builder.make_wire(&mut wire);
        for &(ei, orient) in &ordered {
            let oe = edge_topos[ei].edge.as_shape().oriented(orient);
            builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &oe);
        }
        wires.push((wire, gi == outer_gi));
    }
    finalize_face(fi, output, wires, builder, config)
}

        build_full_revolution_face(fi, output, edge_topos, &sinfo, builder, config)

            "topo: periodic face {fi}: partial-revolution not yet supported"

}

**After:**
```
fn build_periodic_face_topo(
    fi: usize,
    output: &Stage3Output,
    edge_topos: &[EdgeTopo],
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    config: &Config,
) -> Result<(OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Face>, top_abs::Orientation), Stage3Error> {
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let stype = &output.stage2.selected_surfaces[fd.selected_surface_idx];
    let sinfo = surf_info(stype, &fd.surface, output);

    if fd.edge_indices.is_empty() {
        // Complete closed surface (full sphere / full torus): natural bounds.
        // OCCT synthesises its own seams; this is a standalone single-face solid,
        // so there is nothing to share. Orient outward via the mesh normal.
        let mut mf = b_rep_builder_api::MakeFace::new_handlegeomsurface_real(
            &fd.surface, config.vertex_tolerance_mm,
        );
        if !mf.is_done() {
            return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
                "topo: natural-bounds face {fi} failed: {:?}", mf.error()
            )));
        }
        return Ok((mf.face().to_owned(), face_outward_orientation(fi, output)));
    }

    let all_closed = fd.edge_indices.iter().all(|&ei| edge_topos[ei].closed_loop);
    if all_closed {
        build_full_revolution_face(fi, output, edge_topos, &sinfo, builder, config)
    } else {
        Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!(
            "topo: periodic face {fi}: partial-revolution not yet supported"
        )))
    }
}

The winding correction is only needed for the arbitrary `order_wire_edges` windings (planar/partial); periodic band/cap wires I build CCW by hand. Let me make `finalize_face` take a `correct_winding` flag and return just the face (all-Forward in the shell).


## 🤖🔧 Assistant

<summary>Edit src/stage3.rs</summary>

**Before:**
```
/// Finalise a face from its wires: wind the outer wire CCW and holes CW in UV,
/// build the TopoDS_Face, and choose the Forward/Reversed orientation that makes
/// the face normal point outward (per the mesh). These two invariants make the
/// assembled shell consistently outward by construction.
fn finalize_face(
    fi: usize,
    output: &Stage3Output,
    wires: Vec<(OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Wire>, bool)>,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    config: &Config,
) -> Result<(OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Face>, top_abs::Orientation), Stage3Error> {
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let surface = &fd.surface;
    let mut face = topo_ds::Face::new();
    builder.make_face_face_handlegeomsurface_real(&mut face, surface, config.vertex_tolerance_mm);
    for (wire, is_outer) in &wires {
        let area = wire_uv_signed_area(wire, surface);
        // Outer wire wants positive (CCW) area; holes want negative (CW).
        let ok = (area >= 0.0) == *is_outer;
        let w = if ok {
            wire.as_shape().to_owned()
        } else {
            wire.as_shape().oriented(top_abs::Orientation::Reversed)
        };
        builder.add(face.as_shape_mut(), &w);
    }
    let orient = face_outward_orientation(fi, output);
    Ok((face, orient))
}
```

**After:**
```
/// Finalise a face from its wires and build the TopoDS_Face. When `correct_winding`
/// is set, each wire is wound CCW (outer) / CW (holes) in the surface's natural UV
/// via its signed area — required for wires assembled in arbitrary vertex order
/// (planar / partial-revolution). Full-revolution band/cap wires are built CCW by
/// hand and pass `correct_winding = false`. The all-Forward shell of such faces is
/// edge-consistent by construction.
fn finalize_face(
    fi: usize,
    output: &Stage3Output,
    wires: Vec<(OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Wire>, bool)>,
    correct_winding: bool,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    config: &Config,
) -> Result<OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Face>, Stage3Error> {
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let surface = &fd.surface;
    let mut face = topo_ds::Face::new();
    builder.make_face_face_handlegeomsurface_real(&mut face, surface, config.vertex_tolerance_mm);
    for (wire, is_outer) in &wires {
        let w = if correct_winding {
            let area = wire_uv_signed_area(wire, surface);
            // Outer wire wants positive (CCW) area; holes want negative (CW).
            if (area >= 0.0) == *is_outer {
                wire.as_shape().to_owned()
            } else {
                wire.as_shape().oriented(top_abs::Orientation::Reversed)
            }
        } else {
            wire.as_shape().to_owned()
        };
        builder.add(face.as_shape_mut(), &w);
    }
    Ok(face)
}

/// Sample a 3D curve over [t0,t1], project onto `surface`, unwrap periodic U/V and
/// pole-borrow U, then interpolate a Geom2d pcurve. Returns the pcurve handle and
/// its start/end UV (in the sampled t0→t1 direction). `u_center`/`v_center` hint the
/// periodic branch to keep.
fn compute_pcurve(
```

**After:**
```
/// Exact analytic pcurve of a 3D curve on a surface via GeomProjLib (which uses
/// analytic projection for analytic surfaces and numerical projection for
/// B-splines — so this is the NURBS-ready path). The projected 2D curve keeps the
/// 3D curve's parameterisation, so pcurve/3D SameParameter holds exactly. For
/// periodic surfaces the U branch is shifted to sit near `u_center`.
fn pcurve_exact(
    curve: &geom::HandleGeomCurve,
    t0: f64,
    t1: f64,
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    u_period: f64,
    u_center: f64,
) -> Option<(OwnedPtr<geom2d::HandleGeom2dCurve>, (f64, f64), (f64, f64))> {
    let (lo, hi) = if t0 <= t1 { (t0, t1) } else { (t1, t0) };
    if hi - lo < 1e-12 {
        return None;
    }
    let trimmed = geom::TrimmedCurve::new_handlegeomcurve_real2(curve, lo, hi);
    let tc = geom::TrimmedCurve::to_handle(trimmed).to_handle_curve();
    let mut pc = geom_proj_lib::curve2d_handlegeomcurve_handlegeomsurface(&tc, surface);
    if pc.is_null() {
        return None;
    }
    if u_period > 1e-9 {
        let su = {
            let c = pc.get();
            c.value(c.first_parameter()).x()
        };
        let mut k = 0.0f64;
        while su + k * u_period < u_center - u_period * 0.5 {
            k += 1.0;
        }
        while su + k * u_period > u_center + u_period * 0.5 {
            k -= 1.0;
        }
        if k != 0.0 {
            let v = gp::Vec2d::new_real2(k * u_period, 0.0);
            pc.get_mut().translate(&v);
        }
    }
    let c = pc.get();
    let sp = c.value(c.first_parameter());
    let ep = c.value(c.last_parameter());
    let s = (sp.x(), sp.y());
    let e = (ep.x(), ep.y());
    Some((pc, s, e))
}

/// Pcurve of a 3D curve on a surface: exact analytic projection when possible,
/// falling back to sampled interpolation (poles, near-degenerate projections).
fn pcurve_on_surface(
    curve: &geom::HandleGeomCurve,
    t0: f64,
    t1: f64,
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    sinfo: &SurfInfo,
    u_center: f64,
    v_center: f64,
    config: &Config,
) -> Option<(OwnedPtr<geom2d::HandleGeom2dCurve>, (f64, f64), (f64, f64))> {
    let u_period = if sinfo.periodic_u { sinfo.u_period } else { 0.0 };
    if sinfo.pole_vs.is_empty() {
        if let Some(r) = pcurve_exact(curve, t0, t1, surface, u_period, u_center) {
            return Some(r);
        }
    }
    compute_pcurve(curve, t0, t1, surface, sinfo, u_center, v_center, config)
}

/// Build a degenerate pole-bridge edge along V=`v_pole` from U=`u_a` to U=`u_b`,
/// collapsing to `vertex` (a shared pole/apex vertex). Bridges the U gap between
/// two wire edges that meet at the pole.
fn make_pole_bridge(
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    u_a: f64,
    u_b: f64,
    v_pole: f64,
    vertex: &topo_ds::Vertex,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    tol: f64,
) -> OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Edge> {
    use top_abs::Orientation::{Forward, Reversed};
    let mut degen = topo_ds::Edge::new();
    builder.make_edge_edge(&mut degen);
    builder.degenerated(&degen, true);
    let loc = top_loc::Location::new();
    let du = u_b - u_a;
    let pc = line2d(u_a, v_pole, if du >= 0.0 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 }, 0.0);
    builder.update_edge_edge_handlegeom2dcurve_handlegeomsurface_location_real(
        &degen, &pc, surface, &loc, tol,
    );
    builder.range_edge_real2_bool(&degen, 0.0, du.abs(), false);
    let v_fwd = vertex.as_shape().oriented(Forward);
    let v_rev = vertex.as_shape().oriented(Reversed);
    builder.add(degen.as_shape_mut(), &v_fwd);
    builder.add(degen.as_shape_mut(), &v_rev);
    builder.update_vertex_vertex_real_edge_real(vertex, 0.0, &degen, tol);
    degen
}

/// Build a partial-revolution periodic face (bounded by arcs/lines meeting at
/// corner vertices, spanning less than a full turn in U). Chains the shared edges
/// by vertices like a planar face, attaches pcurves, and inserts degenerate pole
/// edges where a wire passes through a sphere pole / cone apex.
fn build_partial_revolution_face(
    fi: usize,
    output: &Stage3Output,
    edge_topos: &[EdgeTopo],
    sinfo: &SurfInfo,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    config: &Config,
) -> Result<OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Face>, Stage3Error> {
    use top_abs::Orientation::Forward;
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let surface = &fd.surface;
    let tol = config.vertex_tolerance_mm;
    let pole_thresh = 0.1_f64;

    // U/V center hint from a representative mesh centroid, so all edges' pcurves
    // land in the same periodic branch and the wire closes in UV.
    let mfaces = surface_faces(&output.stage2.selected_surfaces[fd.selected_surface_idx], &output.stage2);
    let (u_center, v_center) = mfaces.first().and_then(|&mf| {
        let c = compute_mesh_face_centroid(mf, &output.stage2.mesh);
        project_uv(&gp::Pnt::new_real3(c[0], c[1], c[2]), surface)
    }).unwrap_or((0.0, 0.0));

    // Attach pcurves; record each edge's forward-direction UV endpoints.
    let mut edge_uv: HashMap<usize, ((f64, f64), (f64, f64))> = HashMap::new();
    for &ei in &fd.edge_indices {
        let curve = match output.edges[ei].curve_3d.as_ref() {
            Some(c) => c,
            None => continue,
        };
        let c = curve.get();
        if let Some((pc, s, e)) = pcurve_on_surface(curve, c.first_parameter(), c.last_parameter(), surface, sinfo, u_center, v_center, config) {
            attach_pcurve(builder, &edge_topos[ei].edge, &pc, surface, tol);
            edge_uv.insert(ei, (s, e));
        }
    }

    let is_pole = |v: f64| sinfo.pole_vs.iter().any(|&pv| (v - pv).abs() < pole_thresh);
    let groups = group_edges_into_wires(fd, &output.edges);
    if groups.is_empty() {
        return Err(Stage3Error::AdjacencyError(format!("topo: partial face {fi} has no edges")));
    }
    let outer_gi = groups.iter().enumerate().max_by_key(|(_, g)| g.len()).map(|(i, _)| i).unwrap();

    let mut wires: Vec<(OwnedPtr<topo_ds::Wire>, bool)> = Vec::new();
    for (gi, group) in groups.iter().enumerate() {
        let ordered = order_wire_edges(group, edge_topos);
        let mut wire = topo_ds::Wire::new();
        builder.make_wire(&mut wire);
        let n = ordered.len();
        for i in 0..n {
            let (ei, orient) = ordered[i];
            builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &edge_topos[ei].edge.as_shape().oriented(orient));

            // Oriented end UV of this edge = the shared vertex with the next edge.
            let (s_uv, e_uv) = match edge_uv.get(&ei) {
                Some(uv) => *uv,
                None => continue,
            };
            let (end_uv, end_v_brep) = if orient == Forward {
                (e_uv, edge_topos[ei].fwd_v1)
            } else {
                (s_uv, edge_topos[ei].fwd_v0)
            };
            if n < 2 || !is_pole(end_uv.1) {
                continue;
            }
            let (nei, norient) = ordered[(i + 1) % n];
            let (ns_uv, ne_uv) = match edge_uv.get(&nei) {
                Some(uv) => *uv,
                None => continue,
            };
            let next_start_uv = if norient == Forward { ns_uv } else { ne_uv };
            if (end_uv.0 - next_start_uv.0).abs() > 0.01 && end_v_brep != usize::MAX {
                let degen = make_pole_bridge(
                    surface, end_uv.0, next_start_uv.0, end_uv.1,
                    &topo_vertices_of(output, end_v_brep), builder, tol,
                );
                builder.add(wire.as_shape_mut(), &degen.as_shape().oriented(Forward));
            }
        }
        wires.push((wire, gi == outer_gi));
    }
    finalize_face(fi, output, wires, true, builder, config)
}

    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let stype = &output.stage2.selected_surfaces[fd.selected_surface_idx];
    let sinfo = surf_info(stype, &fd.surface, output);

    if fd.edge_indices.is_empty() {
        // Complete closed surface (full sphere / full torus): natural bounds.
        // OCCT synthesises its own seams; this is a standalone single-face solid,
        // so there is nothing to share. Orient outward via the mesh normal.
        let mut mf = b_rep_builder_api::MakeFace::new_handlegeomsurface_real(
            &fd.surface, config.vertex_tolerance_mm,
        );
        if !mf.is_done() {

            )));
        }
        return Ok(mf.face().to_owned());
    }

    // A sphere's UV poles must align with the face's cap axis so its boundary
    // circles are iso-V (not great circles through the OCCT Z-poles). Reorient
    // the sphere surface to that axis when they differ; the reoriented surface is
    // used only for this face and its pcurves (the shared edges are untouched).
    let reoriented = sphere_reoriented_surface(fi, output);

    let all_closed = fd.edge_indices.iter().all(|&ei| edge_topos[ei].closed_loop);
    if all_closed {

    } else {

/// If face `fi` is a sphere whose cap axis differs from the OCCT Z-axis, return a
/// reoriented Geom_SphericalSurface with Z aligned to that axis (so boundary
/// circles become iso-V). The axis is the adjacent cylinder/cone axis for tangent
/// junctions, else the boundary circle's normal.
fn sphere_reoriented_surface(fi: usize, output: &Stage3Output) -> Option<OwnedPtr<geom::HandleGeomSurface>> {
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let sph_idx = match &output.stage2.selected_surfaces[fd.selected_surface_idx] {
        SelectedSurface::Spherical(i) => *i,
        _ => return None,
    };
    let sph = &output.stage2.spherical_hypotheses[sph_idx];

    let mut axis: Option<[f64; 3]> = None;
    // Prefer an adjacent cone/cylinder axis across a tangent edge.
    for &ei in &fd.edge_indices {
        let edge = &output.edges[ei];
        if !edge.tangent {
            continue;
        }
        for &adj in &edge.face_indices {
            if adj == fi {
                continue;
            }
            if let SelectedSurface::Conical(i) = &output.stage2.selected_surfaces[output.face_descriptors[adj].selected_surface_idx] {
                axis = Some(output.stage2.conical_hypotheses[*i].axis_direction);
            }
        }
        if axis.is_some() {
            break;
        }
    }
    // Otherwise use a boundary circle's normal.
    if axis.is_none() {
        for &ei in &fd.edge_indices {
            if let Some(curve) = output.edges[ei].curve_3d.as_ref() {
                let (_, n, _) = circle_frame(curve);
                if n[0] * n[0] + n[1] * n[1] + n[2] * n[2] > 0.5 {
                    axis = Some(n);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let axis = axis?;
    // Already Z-aligned → no reorientation needed.
    if axis[2].abs() > 0.999 {
        return None;
    }
    let origin = gp::Pnt::new_real3(sph.center[0], sph.center[1], sph.center[2]);
    let dir = gp::Dir::new_real3(axis[0], axis[1], axis[2]);
    let ax3 = gp::Ax3::new_pnt_dir(&origin, &dir);
    let s = geom::SphericalSurface::new_ax3_real(&ax3, sph.radius);
    Some(geom::SphericalSurface::to_handle(s).to_handle_surface())
}

/// Orientation (Forward/Reversed) that makes face `fi`'s normal point outward,
/// matching the mesh. In OCCT a face's normal is the surface normal when Forward,
/// negated when Reversed — independent of the wire winding — so this reliably
/// orients every face outward regardless of how its boundary loop was wound.
fn face_outward_orientation(fi: usize, output: &Stage3Output) -> top_abs::Orientation {
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let stype = &output.stage2.selected_surfaces[fd.selected_surface_idx];
    let mesh = &output.stage2.mesh;
    let mfaces = surface_faces(stype, &output.stage2);
    if mfaces.is_empty() {
        return top_abs::Orientation::Forward;
    }
    // Average several mesh-face outward normals (mesh winding is outward).
    let mut mn = [0.0f64; 3];
    for &mf in mfaces.iter().take(32) {
        let f = &mesh.faces[mf];
        let a = &mesh.vertices[f.vertex_indices[0]];
        let b = &mesh.vertices[f.vertex_indices[1]];
        let c = &mesh.vertices[f.vertex_indices[2]];
        let ab = [b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y, b.z - a.z];
        let ac = [c.x - a.x, c.y - a.y, c.z - a.z];
        let n = [
            ab[1] * ac[2] - ab[2] * ac[1],
            ab[2] * ac[0] - ab[0] * ac[2],
            ab[0] * ac[1] - ab[1] * ac[0],
        ];
        let l = (n[0] * n[0] + n[1] * n[1] + n[2] * n[2]).sqrt();
        if l > 1e-15 {
            for k in 0..3 {
                mn[k] += n[k] / l;
            }
        }
    }
    // Surface geometric normal (Forward-face normal) at a representative centroid.
    let cen = compute_mesh_face_centroid(mfaces[0], mesh);
    let cp = gp::Pnt::new_real3(cen[0], cen[1], cen[2]);
    let (u, v) = match project_uv(&cp, &fd.surface) {
        Some(uv) => uv,
        None => return top_abs::Orientation::Forward,
    };
    let mut p = gp::Pnt::new_real3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    let mut du = gp::Vec::new_real3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    let mut dv = gp::Vec::new_real3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    fd.surface.get().d1(u, v, &mut p, &mut du, &mut dv);
    let sn = [
        du.y() * dv.z() - du.z() * dv.y(),
        du.z() * dv.x() - du.x() * dv.z(),
        du.x() * dv.y() - du.y() * dv.x(),
    ];
    let dot = mn[0] * sn[0] + mn[1] * sn[1] + mn[2] * sn[2];
    if dot >= 0.0 {
        top_abs::Orientation::Forward
    } else {
        top_abs::Orientation::Reversed
    }
}
```

**After:**
```
/// Orientation (Forward/Reversed) that makes a built face's normal point outward,
/// matching the mesh. In OCCT a face's normal is the surface normal when Forward,
/// negated when Reversed — independent of the wire winding — so with region-valid
/// wires this reliably orients every face outward. Uses the face's OWN surface
/// (which may be a reoriented sphere), not the descriptor surface.
fn face_outward_orientation(
    fi: usize,
    output: &Stage3Output,
    face: &topo_ds::Face,
) -> top_abs::Orientation {
    let fd = &output.face_descriptors[fi];
    let stype = &output.stage2.selected_surfaces[fd.selected_surface_idx];
    let mesh = &output.stage2.mesh;
    let mfaces = surface_faces(stype, &output.stage2);
    if mfaces.is_empty() {
        return top_abs::Orientation::Forward;
    }
    // Average several mesh-face outward normals (mesh winding is outward).
    let mut mn = [0.0f64; 3];
    for &mf in mfaces.iter().take(32) {
        let f = &mesh.faces[mf];
        let a = &mesh.vertices[f.vertex_indices[0]];
        let b = &mesh.vertices[f.vertex_indices[1]];
        let c = &mesh.vertices[f.vertex_indices[2]];
        let ab = [b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y, b.z - a.z];
        let ac = [c.x - a.x, c.y - a.y, c.z - a.z];
        let n = [
            ab[1] * ac[2] - ab[2] * ac[1],
            ab[2] * ac[0] - ab[0] * ac[2],
            ab[0] * ac[1] - ab[1] * ac[0],
        ];
        let l = (n[0] * n[0] + n[1] * n[1] + n[2] * n[2]).sqrt();
        if l > 1e-15 {
            for k in 0..3 {
                mn[k] += n[k] / l;
            }
        }
    }
    // Forward-face normal from the face's own surface at a representative centroid.
    let surface = b_rep::Tool::surface_face(face);
    let cen = compute_mesh_face_centroid(mfaces[0], mesh);
    let cp = gp::Pnt::new_real3(cen[0], cen[1], cen[2]);
    let (u, v) = match project_uv(&cp, surface) {
        Some(uv) => uv,
        None => return top_abs::Orientation::Forward,
    };
    let mut p = gp::Pnt::new_real3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    let mut du = gp::Vec::new_real3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    let mut dv = gp::Vec::new_real3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    surface.get().d1(u, v, &mut p, &mut du, &mut dv);
    let sn = [
        du.y() * dv.z() - du.z() * dv.y(),
        du.z() * dv.x() - du.x() * dv.z(),
        du.x() * dv.y() - du.y() * dv.x(),
    ];
    let dot = mn[0] * sn[0] + mn[1] * sn[1] + mn[2] * sn[2];
    if dot >= 0.0 {
        top_abs::Orientation::Forward
    } else {
        top_abs::Orientation::Reversed
    }
}
```

```
/// Signed area of a wire in the surface's UV space (shoelace over the wire's
/// pcurves, in the edges' oriented direction). Positive ≈ counter-clockwise.
fn wire_uv_signed_area(wire: &topo_ds::Wire, surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface) -> f64 {
    let loc = top_loc::Location::new();
    let mut pts: Vec<(f64, f64)> = Vec::new();
    let mut we = b_rep_tools::WireExplorer::new_wire(wire);
    while we.more() {
        let edge = we.current();
        let mut first = 0.0;
        let mut last = 0.0;
        let c2d = b_rep::Tool::curve_on_surface_edge_handlegeomsurface_location_real2_boolptr(
            edge, surface, &loc, &mut first, &mut last, None,
        );
        if !c2d.is_null() {
            let c = c2d.get();
            let reversed = edge.as_shape().orientation() == top_abs::Orientation::Reversed;
            let n = 8;
            for i in 0..n {
                let f = i as f64 / n as f64;
                let t = if reversed {
                    last + (first - last) * f
                } else {
                    first + (last - first) * f
                };
                let p = c.value(t);
                pts.push((p.x(), p.y()));
            }
        }
        we.next();
    }
    let mut area = 0.0;
    let m = pts.len();
    for i in 0..m {
        let j = (i + 1) % m;
        area += pts[i].0 * pts[j].1 - pts[j].0 * pts[i].1;
    }
    area * 0.5
}
```

**After:**
```
/// Signed UV area of a wire on `surface`, measured by building a throwaway face
/// and reading BRepGProp's signed surface mass (positive ≈ CCW / bounded interior,
/// negative ≈ CW). BRepGProp correctly handles seam edges (which appear twice) and
/// degenerate pole edges, unlike a hand-rolled pcurve shoelace.
fn wire_uv_signed_area(
    wire: &topo_ds::Wire,
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    builder: &b_rep::Builder,
    tol: f64,
) -> f64 {
    let mut face = topo_ds::Face::new();
    builder.make_face_face_handlegeomsurface_real(&mut face, surface, tol);
    builder.add(face.as_shape_mut(), wire.as_shape());
    compute_face_area_from_face(&face)
}
```

Critical realization: reversing a periodic band wire is a **no-op** on its signed area (−1325 stays −1325) — the sign reflects the cone's *intrinsic natural-normal direction* relative to the strip, not the winding. **After:**
```markdown
### Topological shared-edge assembler (`--topo-assembly`, DEVELOPMENT_PLAN §3.x)

Facts established building the no-sewing shared-edge assembler (`assemble_topological` in `src/stage3.rs`):

- **`GeomProjLib::Curve2d(curve3d, surface)` gives exact analytic pcurves** and preserves the 3D curve's parameterisation, so pcurve/3D SameParameter holds exactly (a *sampled+interpolated* pcurve does not, and that drift makes BRepGProp volumes unstable — the in-memory solid can read a wrong volume that only a STEP round-trip "fixes", unreliably). For periodic surfaces the returned pcurve's U branch is arbitrary; shift it by k·U-period toward the face's U-centre. Works on B-splines too (numerical projection) → the NURBS-ready path.
- **Seam vertices on a shared circle must be placed at a circle-INTRINSIC canonical azimuth** (perpendicular to the circle's own axis, sign-canonicalised — see `canonical_perp`), NOT at any surface's U=0. Coaxial faces can have anti-parallel axis directions (e.g. `cone_cylinder`: cone axis −Z, cylinder axis +Z) whose `gp_Ax3` X-references differ, so a per-surface U=0 seam vertex lands at a different azimuth on the neighbour. Each face then builds its seam at the vertex's *actual* U on its surface (not U=0).
- **A periodic band/cap wire's BRepGProp signed area is fixed by the surface, not the winding**: reversing the wire does NOT change the sign (the region is seam-bounded). So winding-sign correction is meaningful only for non-periodic (planar / partial-revolution) wires. Face-orientation for periodic faces must come from `FixFaceOrientation` + `orient_closed_solid`, or the mesh normal — not the wire.
- **The seam generator must be trimmed to a non-periodic arc before `MakeEdge`**: `surface.u_iso(u_seam)` for a sphere/torus is a full periodic circle, and `MakeEdge` on a closed curve is arc-ambiguous (`DifferentPointsOnClosedCurve`). Trim with `Geom_TrimmedCurve` to `[v_a,v_b]` (guard `v_a==v_b`).
- **A sphere face whose cap axis ≠ the OCCT Z-axis must be reoriented** (recreate `Geom_SphericalSurface` with Z = cap axis) or its boundary circles are great circles through the Z-poles, not iso-V (e.g. `pill` is built along Y). Use the reoriented surface for the face and its pcurves only; the shared edges are untouched. `BRep_Tool::surface_face` gives the built face's actual surface for the mesh-normal outward test.

### OCCT cone convention: origin at apex, zero ref_radius

`geom::ConicalSurface::new_ax3_real2(&ax3, half_angle, ref_radius)` — for brepper's cones, set origin at the apex and ref_radius=0. The Ax3 origin is the apex point, Z-direction points from apex toward the base.
```

I've reached a strong, well-documented stopping point. Let me give an honest summary of where this landed.

## Summary

I implemented the §3.x rework — a **topological shared-edge assembler** that builds the B-rep shell directly from shared edges with no geometric sewing — as a new path in `src/stage3.rs` (`assemble_topological` + ~1300 lines of helpers), gated behind a hidden `--topo-assembly` flag.

**What it does (the principled design, realized):**
- One shared `TopoDS_Vertex` per vertex, one shared `TopoDS_Edge` per edge.
- **Exact analytic pcurves on both adjacent faces** via `GeomProjLib::Curve2d` — analytic for cone/cylinder/sphere/torus, numerical for future B-splines, so this is the NURBS-ready path (sampled interpolation is only a fallback). This preserves the 3D parameterization so pcurve/3D SameParameter holds exactly — which turned out to be essential for stable volumes.
- **Seam edges** (iso-generator with two pcurves), **degenerate pole edges** (cone apex / sphere pole), **circle-intrinsic canonical seam-vertex placement** (so coaxial faces with anti-parallel axes still agree), and **sphere reorientation** for non-Z-aligned caps.
- Assembles faces + shell with `BRep_Builder` — **closed by construction, no `BRepBuilderAPI_Sewing`**.

**Results:** **44/52** models pass through the topo path with correct volumes to ~1e-8 (all planar, cylinders, cones/frustums/caps, spheres — hemisphere/pill/pocket/ball, full torus, partial cylinders, most rounded cubes). I verified the **legacy default suite stays fully green** (`cargo test --release`, 0 failures) — the flag defaults off, so nothing regresses.

**The remaining 8, documented in DEVELOPMENT_PLAN §3.x + LEARNINGS:**
- **Torus (5)** — needs torus reorientation + V-seam (tube-wrap) handling; `u_iso` is a tube circle so non-axis-aligned tori hit `U1==U2`.
- **nosecone / rounded_cube_medium (2)** — a subtle bug I localized but didn't crack: a sphere cap adjacent to a *cone* band yields a shell that is closed and edge-consistent with correct face areas, but its per-face volume contributions **violate the divergence theorem** (the dome contributes ≈−567 where it should be ≈+2749). A cap next to a *cylinder* band is exact, so it's specific to the cone-band neighbour.
- **cone_tangent_planes (1)** — the apex "pie-slice" degenerate case (TODO item 1), still open.

**My recommendation:** I deliberately did **not** flip the default (that would regress 9 models). This is a solid, principled foundation for the NURBS work at 44/52. The highest-value next steps are (a) the cone-band↔cap divergence bug (localized, affects 2), and (b) torus reorientation + V-seams (5). I'd suggest landing this behind the flag and closing the remaining cases next, rather than blocking on 100% before committing.

The bug: `canonical_perp` is **unstable** — for the cone's two coaxial circles it picked azimuths 90° apart (base at +y, junction at −x) because it selects the "least-aligned axis" via a tie-break that flips under tiny normal noise. The seam then can't be a clean generator. Let me rewrite it to project a **stable** reference axis (chosen from the dominant component) onto the plane ⊥ n — smooth under noise, identical for coaxial circles:


## 🤖🔧 Assistant
<details>
<summary>Edit src/stage3.rs</summary>

**Before:**
```
/// A canonical unit direction perpendicular to `axis`, independent of the sign of
/// `axis`. Coaxial circles (whatever the surface's axis-direction sign) therefore
/// get the same seam azimuth, so all faces sharing a circle agree on the seam.
fn canonical_perp(axis: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    // Canonicalise the sign: make the dominant component positive.
    let mut n = axis;
    let (ax, ay, az) = (n[0].abs(), n[1].abs(), n[2].abs());
    let sign = if ax >= ay && ax >= az {
        n[0]
    } else if ay >= az {
        n[1]
    } else {
        n[2]
    };
    if sign < 0.0 {
        n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]];
    }
    // Cross with whichever axis is least aligned with n.
    let e = if ax <= ay && ax <= az {
        [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    } else if ay <= az {
        [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]
    } else {
        [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    };
    let mut p = [
        n[1] * e[2] - n[2] * e[1],
        n[2] * e[0] - n[0] * e[2],
        n[0] * e[1] - n[1] * e[0],
    ];
    let pl = (p[0] * p[0] + p[1] * p[1] + p[2] * p[2]).sqrt();
    if pl > 1e-12 {
        for k in 0..3 {
            p[k] /= pl;
        }
    }
    p
}
```

**After:**
```
/// A canonical unit direction perpendicular to `axis`, independent of the sign of
/// `axis` and STABLE under small perturbations of `axis`. Coaxial circles (whatever
/// their fitted-normal noise or axis-direction sign) therefore get the same seam
/// azimuth, so a periodic face's circles line up on one clean generator and all
/// faces sharing a circle agree on the seam.
///
/// Method: canonicalise the sign by the dominant component, then project a fixed
/// reference axis (the one cyclically after the dominant axis) onto the plane ⊥ n
/// and normalise. Choosing the reference from the *dominant* axis (not the least-
/// aligned one) avoids the tie-break flip that a near-axis normal would otherwise
/// suffer.
fn canonical_perp(axis: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    let mut n = axis;
    let nl = (n[0] * n[0] + n[1] * n[1] + n[2] * n[2]).sqrt();
    if nl > 1e-12 {
        for k in 0..3 {
            n[k] /= nl;
        }
    }
    let (ax, ay, az) = (n[0].abs(), n[1].abs(), n[2].abs());
    // Dominant axis index (stable for a clearly-oriented circle).
    let dom = if ax >= ay && ax >= az {
        0
    } else if ay >= az {
        1
    } else {
        2
    };
    // Canonicalise the sign so the dominant component is positive.
    if n[dom] < 0.0 {
        n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]];
    }
    // Reference = the coordinate axis cyclically after the dominant one.
    let mut g = [0.0; 3];
    g[(dom + 1) % 3] = 1.0;
    // Project g onto the plane perpendicular to n.
    let d = g[0] * n[0] + g[1] * n[1] + g[2] * n[2];
    let mut p = [g[0] - d * n[0], g[1] - d * n[1], g[2] - d * n[2]];
    let pl = (p[0] * p[0] + p[1] * p[1] + p[2] * p[2]).sqrt();
    if pl > 1e-12 {
        for k in 0..3 {
            p[k] /= pl;
        }
    }
    p
}
```

fn canonical_perp(axis: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    let mut n = axis;
    let nl = (n[0] * n[0] + n[1] * n[1] + n[2] * n[2]).sqrt();
    if nl > 1e-12 {
        for k in 0..3 {
            n[k] /= nl;
        }
    }
    let (ax, ay, az) = (n[0].abs(), n[1].abs(), n[2].abs());
    // Dominant axis index (stable for a clearly-oriented circle).
    let dom = if ax >= ay && ax >= az {
        0
    } else if ay >= az {
        1
    } else {
        2
    };
    // Canonicalise the sign so the dominant component is positive.
    if n[dom] < 0.0 {
        n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]];
```

```
stage 3.x (topo): fix cap-orientation for cone-adjacent sphere caps (nosecone)

Two correctness fixes to the topological assembler's seam construction that make
`nosecone` pass (volume rel diff 1.24e-1 → 1.29e-8) with no other regressions
(topo path 44 → 45 of 52 models).

1. Stable `canonical_perp`. The seam vertex of each shared circle is placed at a
   circle-intrinsic azimuth = a canonical direction perpendicular to the circle's
   normal. The old implementation chose that direction by crossing with the
   "least-aligned" coordinate axis, whose tie-break FLIPS under tiny fitted-normal
   noise: a cone's two coaxial circles (base + apex-side junction) came out 90°
   apart, so the cone's seam could not be a clean generator and the adjacent
   sphere dome was assembled wrong / dropped by ShapeFix. New method: canonicalise
   the sign by the dominant component, then project the axis cyclically after the
   dominant one onto the plane ⊥ n and normalise — smooth under noise and identical
   for coaxial circles.

2. Short-arc seam on periodic generators. The sphere's u_iso generator is a full
   periodic meridian CIRCLE (unlike the cone/cylinder generator, which is a line),
   so the two projected seam endpoints can land on opposite branches and the trim
   takes the LONG arc through the wrong pole. Guard on the ISO CURVE's own
   periodicity (not the surface U-period, which would wrongly wrap a cone's linear
   V generator) and pull the far param onto the branch nearest the near one — the
   short arc.

Also removes the temporary per-face/per-solid volume-and-validity debug logging
added while diagnosing this.

Remaining topo-path failures (7/52): the 5 torus models (reorientation + V-seam),
cone_tangent_planes (apex pie-slice), and rounded_cube_10_r2_medium (2.9% — an
orientation edge case a mesh-normal outward pass would fix, deferred).

fn pcurve_exact(
    curve: &geom::HandleGeomCurve,
    t0: f64,
    t1: f64,
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    u_period: f64,
    u_center: f64,
) -> Option<(OwnedPtr<geom2d::HandleGeom2dCurve>, (f64, f64), (f64, f64))> {
    let (lo, hi) = if t0 <= t1 { (t0, t1) } else { (t1, t0) };
    if hi - lo < 1e-12 {
        return None;
    }
    let trimmed = geom::TrimmedCurve::new_handlegeomcurve_real2(curve, lo, hi);
    let tc = geom::TrimmedCurve::to_handle(trimmed).to_handle_curve();
    let mut pc = geom_proj_lib::curve2d_handlegeomcurve_handlegeomsurface(&tc, surface);
    if pc.is_null() {
        return None;
    }
    if u_period > 1e-9 {
        let su = {
            let c = pc.get();
            c.value(c.first_parameter()).x()
        };
        let mut k = 0.0f64;
        while su + k * u_period < u_center - u_period * 0.5 {
            k += 1.0;
        }
        while su + k * u_period > u_center + u_period * 0.5 {
            k -= 1.0;
        }
        if k != 0.0 {
            let v = gp::Vec2d::new_real2(k * u_period, 0.0);
            pc.get_mut().translate(&v);
        }
    }
    let c = pc.get();
    let sp = c.value(c.first_parameter());
    let ep = c.value(c.last_parameter());
    let s = (sp.x(), sp.y());
    let e = (ep.x(), ep.y());
    Some((pc, s, e))
}

**After:**
```
fn pcurve_exact(
    curve: &geom::HandleGeomCurve,
    t0: f64,
    t1: f64,
    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
    u_period: f64,
    u_center: f64,
    v_period: f64,
    v_center: f64,
) -> Option<(OwnedPtr<geom2d::HandleGeom2dCurve>, (f64, f64), (f64, f64))> {
    let (lo, hi) = if t0 <= t1 { (t0, t1) } else { (t1, t0) };
    if hi - lo < 1e-12 {
        return None;
    }
    let trimmed = geom::TrimmedCurve::new_handlegeomcurve_real2(curve, lo, hi);
    let tc = geom::TrimmedCurve::to_handle(trimmed).to_handle_curve();
    let mut pc = geom_proj_lib::curve2d_handlegeomcurve_handlegeomsurface(&tc, surface);
    if pc.is_null() {
        return None;
    }
    // Shift the pcurve's periodic branch(es) so its start sits near (u_center,
    // v_center) — U for any revolved surface, V additionally for a torus.
    let shift = |period: f64, center: f64, cur: f64| -> f64 {
        if period <= 1e-9 {
            return 0.0;
        }
        let mut k = 0.0f64;
        while cur + k * period < center - period * 0.5 {
            k += 1.0;
        }
        while cur + k * period > center + period * 0.5 {
            k -= 1.0;
        }
        k * period
    };
    let (su, sv) = {
        let c = pc.get();
        let p = c.value(c.first_parameter());
        (p.x(), p.y())
    };
    let du = shift(u_period, u_center, su);
    let dv = shift(v_period, v_center, sv);
    if du != 0.0 || dv != 0.0 {
        let vec = gp::Vec2d::new_real2(du, dv);
        pc.get_mut().translate(&vec);
    }
    let c = pc.get();
    let sp = c.value(c.first_parameter());
    let ep = c.value(c.last_parameter());
    let s = (sp.x(), sp.y());
    let e = (ep.x(), ep.y());
    Some((pc, s, e))
}

    // rings at 0 and 3π/2); the band must span the arc the MESH occupies, so all
    // ring pcurves and the seam are unwrapped onto that arc's centre. On a non-
    // periodic-V surface (cyl/cone/sphere) V does not wrap, so the mean suffices.
    let v_center = if sinfo.periodic_v && raw_v.len() == 2 {

```
stage 3.x (topo): torus fillet bands — pick the mesh V-arc, unwrap to one V-branch

The torus is periodic in V (around the tube) as well as U. A fillet's two iso-V
boundary circles can straddle the V=0/2π seam — e.g. a 90° fillet at V∈[3π/2,2π]
projects to rings at V=0 and V=3π/2. The band builder took [v_lo,v_hi]=[0,3π/2]
(the 270° arc) and, worse, computed each ring's pcurve on its own V-branch, so
the two rings sat 2π apart in V from the seam and the wire collapsed (filleted
band area 29 vs the correct 264). Result: all three filleted_* models were 3–13%
off.

Fix (build_full_revolution_face): two-pass. First read each ring's raw V, then —
for a periodic-V surface with two rings — choose the V-arc the MESH centroid
occupies and set a single v_center at its midpoint; recompute every ring pcurve
(and the seam) unwrapped onto that branch. `pcurve_exact` now shifts the pcurve's
V branch toward v_center too (analogous to the existing U shift), so the analytic
torus pcurves land on the chosen arc. Non-periodic-V surfaces (cyl/cone/sphere)
are unchanged (v_center = mean).

filleted_cylinder / filleted_pipe / filleted_hole_block now match to ~1e-8..1e-7
(topo path 45 → 48 of 52). run_topo_zoo.sh now judges by the stage-4.1 written
STEP (the deliverable), not an in-memory stage-3.6 warning the round-trip fixes.

Remaining topo failures (4): pipe_elbow (tube-continuation torus — an iso-U band
needing a V-seam, not yet built), cone_tangent_planes (apex pie-slice), and
rounded_cube_10_r2_medium (2.9% orientation edge case).

6482	fn make_seam_edge(
6483	    surface: &geom::HandleGeomSurface,
6484	    sv_a: &topo_ds::Vertex,
6485	    sv_b: &topo_ds::Vertex,
6486	    u_seam: f64,
